info.title: GeoChronos Application API
info.description: Production-quality local FastAPI backend integrating GeoChronos Data Foundation and GeoChronos Intelligence Engine for air-gapped Earth Observation analytics (SIH26227).

max_x.title: Max X

max_y.title: Max Y

query.example: Show water bodies that disappeared between 2011 and 2026

include_geojson.description: Whether to include full GeoJSON FeatureCollection in response

use_llm.title: Use Llm
use_llm.description: Whether to invoke local OmniRoute interpreter/synthesizer
